messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=edge-lb-https, trigger=healthcheck-failures (rate > 5/min), severity=page

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-17. Pager: @Mia (oncall-east)

Mia (oncall-east): Ack'd on PD, jumping in. Any early context?

Tom (support): Getting multiple customer reports — requests to our hosted endpoints timeout or return 503s from EU region. Support seeing spike in errors starting ~15m ago.

Raj (sre): Looking at LB metrics — ALB target group showing 50% unhealthy targets in eu-west-1, HEALTHY -> UNHEALTHY transitions with 502/SSL_HANDSHAKE errors.

Ana (network): I see a config push ~18m ago that changed the edge routing rule for host header rewrite on the eu-edge pool. Could cause SNI mismatch if cert mapping differs.

Mia (oncall-east): Can we confirm customer impact? Percent of traffic failing and which customers?

Tom (support): Preliminary: ~8% of overall requests across EU region returning 5xx, two customers (acct-552, acct-998) reporting major degradation.

Raj (sre): Digging into ALB logs: many TLS handshakes aborted with "no shared cipher" and "unknown name" in frontend logs. Looks like SNI not matching the certificate presented.

Carol (eng): That matches the deploy — we rolled a routing policy that rewrites Host to internal names. If Host doesn't match public cert SAN, SNI mismatch happens.

Ana (network): Short-term mitigation: revert the new host-rewrite rule in the edge routing config for eu-west-1. I can push a rollback immediately.

Mia (oncall-east): Do it. Also reduce Route53 TTL for the affected CNAME to 30s to speed any DNS fix if needed. Can someone run the commands and post outputs?

Ana (network): Running rollback now:
```bash
edgectl apply --region eu-west-1 --policy host-rewrite --set disabled --note "rollback - emergency"
```

Ana (network): Done. ALB target health starting to recover (targets unhealthy -> draining -> healthy). Errors dropping in the last 2 min.

Raj (sre): Watching metrics: 5xx rate down from 8% -> 1.2% in EU. TLS handshake errors nearly gone.

Tom (support): Support: customers acct-552 and acct-998 confirming recovery (happy path).

Mia (oncall-east): Nice. Set incident state to "mitigated" but keep monitoring for 30m. Need a brief timeline for postmortem. Who owns RCA?

Carol (eng): I'll drive RCA with Ana & Raj — likely change validation gap: host-rewrite rule not validated against cert mappings for edge SSL.

Raj (sre): We should add a preflight check in the deploy pipeline: 1) verify SNI->cert mapping for any host rewrite, 2) synthetic TLS handshake against a probe list. I'll prototype a check.

Ana (network): Also propose an automated rollback on healthcheck spike for edge routing changes (30s window, >30% targets unhealthy).

Mia (oncall-east): I'll update PagerDuty incident notes and hand off to Carol for RCA. Handoff to next oncall (Raj) at 16:30Z.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-17 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: Carol (eng). Next oncall: Raj (sre).

Mia (oncall-east): Closing the major page. If anything regresses, re-open the thread or page immediately. :thumbsup:

Carol (eng): Adding action items: postmortem draft, deploy pipeline preflight, routing policy unit test, runbook update for host-rewrite rollbacks. I'll share doc link in #postmortems when ready.

Raj (sre): Leaving monitoring alarms on for 2 hours, lowered Route53 TTL remains for 15 minutes then revert to standard.

Tom (support): I'll follow up with impacted customers with timeline and mitigation notes.

incident-bot: Note added to incident: "rollback applied by Ana; root cause suspected host-rewrite vs cert mapping. Monitoring until 16:50Z."

Mia (oncall-east): Thanks all. Handoff complete.
